items.text: Joe Soto is a small business owner running for mayor.

sentences.text: Joe Soto is a small business owner running for mayor.

items.text: Soto supports establishing term limits. His platform also focuses on protecting small businesses and supporting youth. In October 2026, he joined a candidate forum where challengers discussed housing affordability, traffic, video billboards and government transparency.
